column1: # Format: address<TAB>name<TAB>type<TAB>comment<TAB>status   (status = confidence tag, see awto-dan docs/embedded/reversing/README.md)
# Source image: ISP dump of the bus-20 unit (see docs/monitors/README.md). One program per bank.
# Conventions: CODE:xxxx = bank-5 code address, EXTMEM:xxxx = XDATA.
# Open: VCP dispatcher body, VCP table, no-signal / power-save handler.

column4: ddcci_caps_reply(): builds the DDC/CI Capabilities reply (cmd 0xE3). Copies the caps string byte-by-byte into the reply buffer at XDATA 0xDDA9+index; picks the string by (source_class & 0xF).
Loop body of ddcci_caps_reply entered after string A copy; same logic.
Loop body of ddcci_caps_reply entered after string B copy; same logic.
DDC/CI capabilities string A, used when source_class low nibble is 3, 5 or 6. This unit: (prot(monitor)type(LCD)model(RTK)cmds(01 02 03 07 0C E3 F3)vcp(02)mswhql(1)asset_eep(40)mccs_ver(2.2))
DDC/CI capabilities string B, used when source_class low nibble is 4. Identical text on this unit.

Command byte of the current DDC/CI message. Compared in CODE:5fc2 against 0xCD,0xDF,0xD2,0xD0,0xBB,0xDD,0xAB,0xAC,0xD3,0xD4,'H','P' (mostly NOT standard MCCS opcodes: likely Realtek private commands) and in the epilogue against 0x00/0x01/0x03 (reply-length class). Read via helper CODE:efd7. Earlier name ddcci_vcp_opcode was wrong.
Dispatches on ddcci_cmd_byte: 0xCD,0xDF,0xD2,0xD0 call small handlers (0c99, fc2c, fc3f, fc52); 0xDD, 0xBB, 0xAB/0xAC, 'H'/'P', 0xD3, 0xD4 other paths. Role (private/factory vs standard) unconfirmed.

Keil C51 switch table (value, case address) pairs, 3-byte entries [vcp_code][addr_hi][addr_lo], used after LCALL 0x1617 (case helper) with the value from EXTMEM:dd27. Terminated by 0xFC 00 00. Codes: 02 04 05 06 08 0C 0E 10 12 14 16 18 1A 20 30 52 60 62 6C 6E 70 87 CA CC D6. Entries: 10->6CD8, 12->6CF3, 14->6D45, 60->6DDE, CA->6E38, CC->6E0F, D6->6E5B. Table purpose (set vs get) inferred from the set test (D6/60/CC accepted).
Switch case label for VCP 0xD6 inside the big switch (not a function entry; decompiling from here gives unrelated setup code). Observed: value 4 -> reads back standby (2); value 2 ignored; 1 -> on.
Switch case label for VCP 0x60 (writes value DD29 to E05E).
Switch case label for VCP 0xCC: compares DD29 to 5/4/1.
Switch value loaded just before the Keil case helper (LCALL 0x1617) at CODE:6b1a: the VCP feature code of the request. DD28/DD29 are the value bytes (DD29 = low byte, used by the case bodies).

Table of 3-byte entries [handler_hi][handler_lo][vcp_code], starting near CODE:832F. Codes include 04 05 06 08 0B 0C 10 12 14 16 18 1A 1E 20 30 52 60 62 6C 6E 70 7E 87 AC AE B2 B6 ... (the codes ddcutil getvcp known returned). Handler addresses 83AE..85xx.
Number of caps-string bytes to send in this reply chunk.
Loop index while copying the caps string.
Low nibble selects caps string (3/5/6 -> A, 4 -> B). Probably the active input type; meaning unconfirmed.
